The maze floor/ceiling/window OR-blit source WORK BUFFER (the cs:[0x149] 'dataSeg') is the file `mazedata.ega` loaded VERBATIM by ega.drv dispatch entry 6 (FUN_0631); the pixel data is stored ALREADY 4-plane planar on disk. The only transform is a trivial in-place DESCRIPTOR-TABLE NORMALIZATION (split each descriptor's flat blob offset into segment:offset). The offline expander (tools/parity/expand-asset.ts expandMazeData) reproduces the LIVE dataSeg captured at the OR-blit entry on first render BYTE-EXACT (65536/65536 over the captured 0x10000 window; full-file: blob + placements verbatim, only the 153 descriptors rewritten), and every per-image OR-blit SOURCE work-buffer (24 distinct images: ceiling/window/floor/side-panels, the live firstrender wb-*.bin captures) is a byte-exact slice of the expanded buffer at its descriptor's (segDelta*16 + srcOffLow) — 24/24 = 100%. findings.claim: The maze background EXPANDER is ega.drv DISPATCH ENTRY 6 = FUN_0631 (file 0x631..0x734). It is NOT a pixel decompressor. It (1) lseek(0)+int21-read the WHOLE file `mazedata.ega` (102303 bytes) VERBATIM into the cs:[0x149] dataSeg buffer — a 0x800-byte first read for the header/tables, then 0x8000-byte chunks across successive +0x800-paragraph segment bumps for the blob; and (2) NORMALIZES the descriptor table in place so each descriptor's (segDelta:srcOff) addresses the pixel blob within the segmented dataSeg. The pixel blob and the placement records are copied byte-for-byte; only the 153 descriptors are rewritten. There is NO masked/RLE/huffman pixel codec on this path. The OR-blit (entry 15, FUN_0a93) then reads its 4-plane planar sub-images directly from this buffer via the normalized descriptors.

evidence.details: Capstone ega.drv 0x631..0x734: 0x63f mov ds,cs:[0x149]; 0x648 mov bx,[bp+0xc](file handle); 0x64d int21 ah=3f cx=0x800 (header+tables read to ds:0); 0x652 ax=[0](numDesc) *5 +4 -> cs:[0x190](placeOff); 0x662 ax=[2](numPlace) *5 + placeOff -> [bp-2]=blobStart; 0x671 [bp-4]=blobStart&0xf, [bp-2]=blobStart>>4; 0x68b..0x6ad loop cx=numDesc over cs:[0x18e](=4): al=[bx+2]; al+=[bp-4]; [bx+2]=al&0xf; al>>=4; ax=[bx]+al+[bp-2]; [bx]=ax; bx+=5. 0x6c8..0x71f read the rest of the file in 0x8000 chunks (segment +0x800 per chunk) = whole-file verbatim load. Dispatch thunk table file 0x33 -> 0x631 (entry 6). OFFLINE reproduction: expandMazeData(mazedata.ega) == the live dataSeg captured at the OR-blit entry, 65536/65536 (the 0x10000 capture window); full-file normalization keeps the blob (offset>=blobStart=2599) and the placement region byte-identical, rewriting only the 153 descriptors.

findings.claim: `mazedata.ega` (102303 bytes) is the single, universal maze-background graphics file (EGA; mazedata.cga / mazedata.t16 are the CGA / Tandy variants). Layout: [0..1] u16 numDesc (=153); [2..3] u16 numPlace (=366); [4..] numDesc image-descriptor records (5 bytes each: {u16 segDelta, u8 srcOffLow, u8 w, u8 h}); [4+numDesc*5 ..] numPlace placement records (5 bytes each: {u8 imgIdx, u8 destX, u8 destRow, u8 bias, u8 count}); [4+numDesc*5+numPlace*5 = 2599 ..] the 4-plane PLANAR pixel blob (verbatim, 4 contiguous planes of w*h per sub-image). The descriptor table on disk already carries per-image paragraph deltas (segDelta) relative to the blob; FUN_0631 adds the blob base offset (blobStart>>4 = 162 paragraphs, blobStart&0xf = 7) to make them absolute within the loaded dataSeg. After normalization, segDelta ranges 162..6385 (102160 bytes) — spanning the whole file = all view distances.

evidence.details: mazedata.ega[0:8] = 99 00 6e 01 00 00 00 0e (numDesc=153, numPlace=366, then disk desc0 {segDelta=0, srcOffLow=0, w=14, h=87}). placeOff = 153*5+4 = 769 (= captured cs:[0x190]=0x301). blobStart = 366*5+769 = 2599. The on-disk planar blob is found verbatim in mazedata.ega and matches the live OR-blit source byte-exact (e.g. gi2 side-panel = mazedata.ega[9520:] = dataSeg desc3 (segDelta 595*16) — 1807/1807). The full normalized buffer == the live dataSeg (100.000%).

findings.claim: Each (normalized) image descriptor is 5 bytes {u16 segDelta, u8 srcOffLow, u8 w, u8 h}. The OR-blit (FUN_0a93) reads it as: source segment = dataSeg + segDelta; source byte offset = srcOffLow + placement.bias; image width-in-bytes-per-plane-row = w (the si row stride); plane stride = w*h; the 4 planes are contiguous in the source segment (plane p at base + p*w*h). This MATCHES the maze-floor-ceiling-decoder.json OR-blit walk exactly — confirming the expander OUTPUT feeds composeBackground (decode-floor-ceiling.ts applyPlacedImage) unchanged. The mapping was validated by matching each live placed-image's source segment (firstrender placed_images ds) to a descriptor by (w, h, si) and confirming segDelta = ds - dataSeg: gi0 ceiling(w18 h7)->desc44(2082), gi1 window(w18 h16)->desc56(2276), gi4/gi5 floor(w14)->desc45/57, gi2/gi3 side-panel(w4 h112)->desc3/7, all exact.

evidence.details: Capstone ega.drv 0xaf0..0xb1c (OR-blit descriptor read): al=[si](imgIdx); bx=5*al+cs:[0x18e]; w=[bx+3]; planeStride=[bx+3]*[bx+4]; ax=[bx+2]+[si+3](srcOff+bias); ds += [bx](segDelta). Live firstrender placed_images map 1:1 to mazedata.ega descriptors (segDelta = ds - dataSeg(0x2181)). validate-expander.ts: all 24 captured per-image source buffers (ceiling/window/floor/side-panels, w in {3,4,8,9,14,18}) are byte-exact slices of expandMazeData(mazedata.ega) at (segDelta*16) — 24/24 = 100%.

findings.claim: There is NO masked/packed pixel decompression between the on-disk asset and the OR-blit work buffer (the .snd-trap suspicion does not apply here). The maze-background-generation.json 'DECISIVE NEGATIVE: the on-disk floor record blob is NOT a bitwise subset of the OR-blit page -> an EXPAND step exists' was about the SCENARIO.DBS bank-2/3 floor/ceiling records (maze-asset-loader.json), which are NOT the OR-blit source. The OR-blit source is mazedata.ega, whose blob is verbatim 4-plane planar. The bit-position-biased 'packed encoding' the prior pass measured was a property of the SCENARIO.DBS records, which this background path does not consume. (Whether the SCENARIO.DBS floor/ceiling bank records are used by some OTHER subsystem is out of scope; they are not the maze-corridor background source.)

evidence.details: expandMazeData(mazedata.ega).buffer reproduces the live dataSeg + all 24 OR-blit source images byte-exact with the blob copied verbatim (zero pixel transforms). The only writes FUN_0631 makes to the descriptor table are the segment:offset normalization (proven byte-exact). No bit-unpacking, run-length, or mask step exists on the maze-background path.

expander_pseudocode.load: lseek(handle,0); read whole mazedata.ega verbatim into dataSeg (cs:[0x149]).
expander_pseudocode.header: numDesc = u16@0; numPlace = u16@2; placeOff = numDesc*5+4 (-> cs:[0x190]); imgDescOff = 4 (cs:[0x18e]); blobStart = numPlace*5 + placeOff; blobLo = blobStart&0xf; blobHi = blobStart>>4.
expander_pseudocode.normalize_descriptors: for k in 0..numDesc-1 (rec at 4+k*5 = {segDelta u16, srcOffLow u8, w u8, h u8}): al=(srcOffLow+blobLo)&0xff; srcOffLow = al&0xf; segDelta = segDelta + (al>>4) + blobHi.
expander_pseudocode.note: placement records (at placeOff) and the pixel blob (at blobStart) are NOT modified. The OR-blit reads source segment = dataSeg + segDelta, offset = srcOffLow + placement.bias, 4 contiguous planes of w*h.
